entry.title: BACM: shared memory for parallel LLM agents that stays correct when the code changes
entry.summary: Research write-up: a transparent, provenance-aware shared context manager for parallel LLM agents. 89% / 88% accuracy vs 58% / 49% for independent agents, stale answers cut from 61 to 7 of 186. Paper PDF, code and limitations.
